lenses.assessment: No domain string API in either body; closed enums and structured MissingRoofOutlet retain categories. No whole-system assertion.

Names and owner/policy remain to be justified for 0.01/0.02/0.000004 ridge/edge tolerances, 2.20 transverse scale, gutter dimensions/fall/offsets and packed role constants; units and error budgets differ. Do not treat each literal as a separate defect.
RoofAssemblyId, GeometryOwnerId, ResolvedItemId, RoofKind and RoofEdgeKind are present; canonical global item-ID namespace remains open for separate junction/gutter collision.

Checked Architectural SpatialBounds and CollisionCuboid are used at retention boundaries, while roof points, normal, depth, pitch and drainage samples remain raw; compare existing canonical spatial owners before inventing replacements.

Face, edge, catchment, route and network identities are distinct concepts even though encoded through one ResolvedItemId; separate scalar dimensional quantities from true native numerical kernel values.

Ridge extension updates selected face point and matching edge endpoints; plane coherence, squared-distance tolerance and representable operations need producer/consumer proof. Drainage divides by normal.y and polygon length; do not infer valid or invalid geometry from syntax alone.
Parent/child, plane/polygon, face/support and catchment/route/void/network relations require joint invariants. Creation establishes support nodes but broader graph lifecycle remains unproved.

Parent optional metadata does not guard indexed parent use for nonempty dormers; exact program reachability remains open. MissingRoofOutlet is explicit for absent catchment/route, not absent referenced void.
Typed closed DormerKind, RoofChildKind, RoofEdgeKind and RoofPhase are present. Hipped maps to GabledDormer; verify intended receiving meaning before alleging an enum defect.

Plane/polygon and channel/route/catchment/void retain related geometry. On regeneration networks and gutter solids are cleared but support interfaces are not; repeated-call eligibility and consumer rules remain open.

Any future work must preserve current seam depth fallback, child ordering, lexical channel direction, empty-sample fallback, MissingRoofOutlet and later outlet consolidation unless policy intentionally changes. No product behavior validated.

Raw roof geometry and sampled point records reach retention and receivers; older native NATIVE-ROOF-PPS-F001 is specifically checked Position discarded at roof_polygon_bounds, not a blanket claim that every native calculation is defective.
No meaningful handwritten trait or serialization boilerplate occurs in assigned bodies; support data structures derive Clone/Serialize/Deserialize. No change is proposed from this bounded view.
